checks: password login: normalized email, wrong password inline, successful worker redirect
forgot password: domain validation, SMTP error, generic confirmation and resend cooldown
missing/expired link gives a new-link action; secret fragment is removed
reset: incomplete-profile session allowed, matching validation, retry, success clears session
incorrect current password preserves the profile session
login/forgot/reset: responsive, contrast, targets and keyboard focus at 320/390/768/1440px
